decided_in: ADR 0035; values picked by Jose 2026-10-19 (P05 build step 1). Step 6 confirms each against SRV01 before the agent first runs there; any change is a commit, never an edit during a run.
host_scope: SRV01 (member server). DC01 is out of scope (ADR 0033).

watched.name: Spooler
watched.why: Print Spooler disabled on servers is common hardening (PrintNightmare). Breaking it cannot touch WinRM, Kerberos or the agent's connection.

watched.name: Logon
watched.why: Project 1 already reads this subcategory through AgentReader (Get-AgentAuditPolicy). Turning auditing off does not affect the agent's access.

watched.name: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp\UserAuthentication
watched.why: RDP Network Level Authentication on. The agent uses WinRM, not RDP, so the drift cannot lock it out.
